title: Internet client addition (BOW front end, IBT_USER_ADDITION_UPLOAD)
purpose: Creates internet (IBT) client logins in BOW, uploaded from the BOW Admin terminal's upload menu INTERNET RETAIL CLIENTS (the admin chooses the login permissions: thick client, web, mobile). One line per active client that is new or changed since the last file (or every one), except the clients in the offline (CTCL) client groups. Comma-separated, no header, 15 fields (BOW still takes the older 13). Passwords are never written: the Password field is left empty though BOW wants one, so set it in BOW. BOW's file uploader takes it from 17:30 to 08:00.

columns.name: Client ID/Login ID
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. The client's UCC (10 characters at most)

columns.name: Owner Id
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. The admin ID (e.g. T1001) or mini admin ID (miniadmin-T1001) the user is created under: Owner Id in Connections → BOW upload files

columns.name: Client ID/Login ID
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. Repeats the client ID (as in BOW's samples)

columns.name: User Type
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. 1 for a client

columns.name: Password
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. BOW wants an initial password (8 characters or more with a letter, a digit and a special character). Ledgerline NEVER writes passwords: the field is left empty; set it in BOW (or in the file just before uploading)

columns.name: First Name
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. The first word of the client's name

columns.name: Last Name
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. The rest of the name (the first name again when the name is one word)

columns.name: Email Id
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. E-mail from the client master

columns.name: Default Marketwatch
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. Always N

columns.name: Mobile No
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. Mobile number

columns.name: Pan Card No
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. PAN

columns.name: MarginProductPref
columns.note: May be blank: BOW's product preference value for margin (e.g. 1099511627775 = all), from Connections → BOW upload files

columns.name: DeliveryProductPref
columns.note: May be blank: BOW's product preference value for delivery, from Connections → BOW upload files

linked: Live RMS → Front-office files → BOW uploads (IBT user addition)
